items.headline: Crypto exchange volumes double in five days as market activity rebounds
items.summary: The Block reports that centralized-exchange trading volume roughly doubled over five days to above $37B after reaching a yearly low. Activity is recovering, but remains well below the prior 12-month peak, so this is supportive participation context rather than a standalone entry signal.
items.whyItMatters: A recovery in spot exchange activity can improve liquidity and validate renewed market participation, but current volume is still far below the recent cycle peak and does not negate chase risk after the sharp rally.
items.actionReason: Latest Crypto Reca scan at 21:00 Madrid has BTC at D2 / ERS 77 / Entry 3 of 5 and the rest of the universe below executable timing. Treat stronger market activity as confirmation context only; no hard gate changes.

items.headline: Strive acquires 1,110 BTC for $81.5 million, lifting holdings to 21,356 BTC
items.summary: Strive disclosed purchases of 1,110 BTC between Aug. 17 and Aug. 21 at an average price of about $73,409, increasing holdings to 21,356 BTC. This is constructive corporate-demand context, but the purchase occurred during last week's rally and is not a fresh intraday trigger.
items.whyItMatters: Additional corporate treasury accumulation supports the institutional-demand backdrop for BTC, while the transaction size remains too small relative to market capitalization to justify a HIGH impact rating on its own.
items.actionReason: Latest Crypto Reca scan at 21:00 Madrid remains BTC D2 / ERS 77 / Entry 3 of 5, requiring a completed reclaim/hold through roughly 79.0k-79.2k with renewed participation and Coinbase Preview before any add-on.

items.headline: Weekly altcoin ETF flows favor XRP and SOL, with smaller AVAX inflows
items.summary: Block Scholes reported weekly net inflows of about $39.8M for XRP, $28.3M for SOL and $1.3M for AVAX for Aug. 17-21. The flows are constructive institutional context, but they are modest relative to BTC/ETH and do not justify independent entries.
items.whyItMatters: Positive regulated-product flows can support liquidity and demand in XRP, SOL and AVAX, but current magnitudes are not large enough to override setup-specific structure and timing.
items.actionReason: Latest Crypto Reca scan at 21:00 Madrid has XRP D2 / ERS 66 / Entry 2 of 5, SOL D2 / ERS 73 / Entry 2 of 5 but management-only on the existing Tactical thesis, and AVAX D2 / ERS 72 / Entry 2 of 5. No asset has a fresh executable trigger.

items.headline: Bitmine adds 32,447 ETH and reports holdings above 5.84 million ETH
items.summary: Bitmine Immersion said it acquired another 32,447 ETH over the prior week, taking total holdings to 5,847,611 ETH, while more than 5.06 million ETH is staked. The latest addition reinforces ongoing corporate ETH accumulation, but it follows a very sharp weekly ETH advance.
items.whyItMatters: The purchase adds another institutional demand signal for ETH, but the incremental amount is small relative to the treasury's total holdings and does not justify a HIGH classification by itself.
items.actionReason: Latest Crypto Reca scan at 21:00 Madrid has ETH at D2 / ERS 75 / Entry 2 of 5 and no fresh long trigger; this news does not override timing or risk gates.

items.headline: Strategy raises about $2 billion through MSTR sales but makes no bitcoin purchase and builds a new USD Cash pool
items.summary: Strategy reported no bitcoin purchase or sale for Aug. 17-23 despite raising about $2 billion through MSTR sales; it increased its USD reserve and established a separate cash pool. Holdings remain unchanged, so this is a pause in marginal demand rather than a BTC sale.
items.whyItMatters: Strategy is one of the largest corporate bitcoin holders, so the absence of fresh buying removes a potential marginal demand source for now, while the accumulated cash preserves future purchasing capacity.
items.actionReason: Do not treat the corporate purchase pause as an exit signal. Latest Crypto Reca remains constructive on BTC but no fresh add-on has cleared all execution gates.

items.headline: Bitcoin posts largest weekly dollar gain on record after 22.7% advance
items.summary: Bitcoin gained $14,264 during the week ended Aug. 23 and closed at $77,387, a 22.7% seven-day rise. The move confirms powerful momentum but materially increases extension and FOMO/chase risk.
items.whyItMatters: Record weekly momentum supports the higher-timeframe BTC trend, but also increases vulnerability to chasing and mean reversion.
items.actionReason: Latest Crypto Reca scan at 21:00 Madrid remains constructive on BTC, but completed 1H trigger and volume confirmation are still missing.

items.headline: Bitcoin and Ether ETFs posted their strongest combined inflow week since October 2025
items.summary: U.S. spot BTC ETFs recorded about $1.9B of weekly net inflows and spot ETH ETFs about $697.2M, with combined trading volume rising to roughly $29B. The flow reversal is materially supportive, but it followed a sharp weekly price rally and does not by itself justify chasing.
items.whyItMatters: Large renewed institutional spot-ETF demand can support liquidity and trend persistence in BTC and ETH, but the move comes after a large rally and therefore raises chase risk.
items.actionReason: Treat the inflows as supportive context for existing long exposure, not as an independent entry trigger.

items.headline: Solana mainnet begins staged slot-time reduction toward 200 ms
items.summary: Solana cut mainnet target slot time to 350 ms, down from 400 ms, as part of a staged reduction toward 200 ms. The upgrade currently reads as constructive protocol context rather than an operational-risk event.
items.whyItMatters: Lower slot times can improve confirmation latency and network competitiveness, but it is primarily a protocol-quality development rather than a direct flow catalyst.
items.actionReason: Use only as supportive protocol context; current Crypto Reca treatment of SOL remains management-only on the existing Tactical thesis.

catalysts.headline: U.S. July PCE inflation and Personal Income/Outlays release
catalysts.whyItMatters: The PCE price index is a key inflation input for Federal Reserve policy expectations; a material surprise can rapidly move Treasury yields, the dollar and crypto risk appetite.
catalysts.preparationNote: No entry restriction yet. Reassess event risk inside 24h and move to PREPARE VOLATILITY as the release approaches.

catalysts.headline: Fed Chair Kevin Warsh keynote at Jackson Hole
catalysts.whyItMatters: A Jackson Hole keynote by the Fed Chair can materially shift expectations for rates, liquidity and risk assets, including crypto.
catalysts.preparationNote: No need to avoid entries yet solely because of this event; tighten event awareness as the speech approaches and reassess within 24h.
